notes: CardVault application contracts for Sepolia (11155111), in constructor dependency order. All five admins and the initial guardians of CardPool, CardOracle and CardLending are $owner. MockUSDC has name C, symbol AUREON, six decimals and an initial supply of 1,000,000 tokens minted to $owner; subsequent minting is owner-only. MockCardNFT issues card collateral with immutable metadata and derived class IDs. CardPool is the MockUSDC ERC-4626 vault with a segregated loss reserve. CardOracle uses the specified Sepolia Intake and test IMD addresses, and the oracle signer recorded in script/SepoliaConfig.sol and confirmed by https://api.imd.fun/oracle/requests?limit=1 on 2026-10-15. Its constructor fixes the initial request fee at 0.5 IMD and action at bytes32(oracle.request@oracle-1); the attestation domain uses the deployed consumer address and chain. CardLending starts at 12% APR with a 30-day term, 45% borrowing LTV, 1% origination fee and 24-hour liquidation auctions. Accepted-source limitation: CardPool.lending is unset at construction, and borrowing requires the owner's one-time setLending binding to CardLending. Card classes also require owner configuration and the pool requires deposited liquidity. These operations are not encoded as initialization calls in this manifest; constructor deployment alone does not make borrowing operational. No live application deployment, oracle callback or Sepolia borrow is claimed.
